# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview

`pola-barcodes` is a [Jaspr](https://github.com/schultek/jaspr) web application for displaying and managing barcodes used in the [Pola](https://www.pola-app.pl/) project. The site is statically pre-rendered at build time (`jaspr: mode: static`) and hydrated on the client. The live app is hosted at https://klubjagiellonski.github.io/pola-barcodes/.

## Tech Stack

- **Framework:** Jaspr (static rendering mode) with `jaspr_router`
- **Language:** Dart
- **Key dependencies:**
  - [`barcode`](https://pub.dev/packages/barcode) — pure-Dart barcode generation, rendered as inline SVG (`toSvg`)
  - [`slang`](https://pub.dev/packages/slang) — compile-time internationalization (i18n), used without Flutter (`flutter_integration: false`)
  - [`universal_web`](https://pub.dev/packages/universal_web) — `package:web` bindings that also compile on the server (localStorage)

## Project Structure

```
lib/
  main.server.dart           # Server entrypoint; renders the Document during static pre-rendering
  main.client.dart           # Client entrypoint; sets browser locale, hydrates @client components
  main.*.options.dart        # Generated by jaspr_builder — do NOT edit or commit
  app.dart                   # Root @client component; Router with all routes
  barcode_item.dart          # BarcodeItem model; holds description, data string and barcode type
  barcode_item.g.dart        # Generated — do NOT edit manually (from json_serializable)
  barcode_storage.dart       # localStorage persistence of user-added barcodes
  barcode_type.dart          # Barcode type enum + mapping to package:barcode
  pola_api.dart              # HTTP client for the Pola API
  components/
    header.dart              # Top app bar with optional home link
    barcode_view.dart        # Renders a single barcode as inline SVG
    barcodes_list_view.dart  # 2-column grid of barcode tiles
    barcodes_panel.dart      # Form panel for adding a new barcode
  pages/
    barcodes_page.dart       # Main page; list + add-barcode panel
    barcode_detail_page.dart # Barcode detail with Pola API JSON view
  i18n/
    en.i18n.json             # English translations
    pl.i18n.json             # Polish translations (base locale)
    strings.g.dart           # Generated — do NOT edit manually (excluded from analysis)
```

## Routing and static generation

Routes are declared in `lib/app.dart`. The 10 predefined `/code/{name}` routes are listed
explicitly so each is pre-rendered to its own HTML file. Routes with path parameters
(`/code/:name`, `/ean13/:data`, `/ean8/:data`) **must stay inside the `if (kIsWeb)` guard** —
jaspr_router forbids parameterized routes during static-site generation. Deep links to
dynamic routes on GitHub Pages are handled by the `web/404.html` redirect plus the inline
decode script in `main.server.dart`.

## Internationalization

Translations live in `lib/i18n/*.i18n.json`. The base locale is **Polish** (`pl`); pages are
pre-rendered in Polish and the client switches to the browser locale before hydration.
The generated file `lib/i18n/strings.g.dart` is **not** committed; regenerate it with:

```bash
dart run slang
```

Access translations via the global `t` getter (e.g., `t.barcodeList`) or pass a `Translations` instance explicitly (e.g., `BarcodeItem.barcodes(t)`).

## Common Commands

```bash
# One-time: install the Jaspr CLI
dart pub global activate jaspr_cli

# Install dependencies
dart pub get

# Generate i18n code (required before build/run)
dart run slang

# Generate JSON serialization + jaspr options code (required before analyze)
dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs

# Run with hot reload at http://localhost:8080
jaspr serve

# Analyze (lint)
dart analyze

# Build the static site into build/jaspr/
jaspr build --dart-define=BASE_PATH=/pola-barcodes/
```

## Coding Conventions

- Follow standard Dart style enforced by `lints` plus the `jaspr_lints` analyzer plugin.
- Use `const` constructors wherever possible.
- Component files are named after the component they contain, in `snake_case` (e.g., `barcode_view.dart` for `BarcodeView`).
- Styles are defined with the type-safe `@css` static getters on components; global styles live in `main.server.dart`.
- Browser-only APIs (localStorage, HTTP fetch on page load) must be guarded with `kIsWeb` — the same code also runs on the server during pre-rendering.
- When adding or changing user-visible strings, update **both** `en.i18n.json` and `pl.i18n.json`, then regenerate `strings.g.dart`.
- Generated files (`strings.g.dart`, `*.g.dart`, `main.*.options.dart`) are not committed and are excluded from static analysis (see `analysis_options.yaml` and `.gitignore`).
